name: Vile Scourge
body:
Your corruptive power is even more difficult to resist.

Prerequisite(s): Class level 5th, scourge class feature.

Benefit(s): The DC to resist your scourge class ability increases by +1.

Special: You can gain this feat up to three times. Its effects stack.
